canadian-money-calculators.title: Canadian money calculators
canadian-money-calculators.intro: Check a foreign card charge, compare mortgage offers or see how inflation changed the value of your money. Each calculator shows the assumptions behind its answer.

tasks.label: Check a foreign-currency purchase
tasks.help: Use the purchase currency and the amount on your statement to compare your effective rate with a dated reference rate.

tasks.label: Find the tax in a Canadian receipt
tasks.help: Enter a total including tax, select the province and receipt date and see the pre-tax amount and each tax component.

tasks.label: Compare two internet or mobile offers
tasks.help: Enter the promotional months, regular price, credits and fees to compare full-term costs and the first month a switch pays off.

tasks.label: Compare mortgage renewal offers
tasks.help: Enter the same balance and remaining amortization for both offers. Compare total interest and the balance left at the end of the term.

tasks.label: Convert an old Canadian dollar amount
tasks.help: Choose the original and comparison years to translate a historical price into dollars of the other year.

tasks.label: Check whether your raise beat inflation
tasks.help: Compare earnings at the same paid hours and use your province's price index over the period.

tasks.label: How does nursing tuition in Nova Scotia compare with British Columbia?
tasks.help: Compare tuition for the same field and academic year. Follow the separately dated graduate income cohorts to see which graduates and years each figure covers.

field_note.label: Work out how much rent would offset the nursing tuition difference

tasks.label: Find the better grocery deal
tasks.help: Compare different package sizes for the amount you actually need, including multi-buy pricing.

tasks.label: Find the next published benefit payment date
tasks.help: Select your programs and subscribe to their calendars. Each date links to its official publication.

internet-and-isp.title: Canadian internet and ISP checks
internet-and-isp.intro: Compare a speed measurement with other Canadian tests, look up your public IP or investigate a possible outage. Choose the question that matches what you see.

tasks.label: Check for signs of a provider outage
tasks.help: Inspect independent measurements for the network and time in question. A stale signal leaves the present status uncertain.

tasks.label: Compare internet speed by network and city
tasks.help: Enter your download or upload result in Mbps. The sample count and month help you decide whether the comparison is meaningful.

tasks.label: Look up my public IP and network
tasks.help: Request a connection check to see the public address, network and serving edge that the website observes.

tasks.label: Understand a Canadian traceroute
tasks.help: Inspect measured paths or supply your own trace. Check the destination, direction and unknown hops before interpreting a border crossing.

tasks.label: Look up a Canadian telephone prefix
tasks.help: Start with the area code and exchange to learn where a number block is assigned. People can keep a number when they switch carriers.

website-and-email.title: Website history, domain and email checks
website-and-email.intro: Investigate an unfamiliar website, check your domain's mail records or read the headers of a message. Each tool answers a different part of the question.

tasks.label: Check the history of a website
tasks.help: Start with a domain to compare registration evidence, certificate dates and archived pages. Look for changes in who the site claimed to represent.

tasks.label: Check a domain's email DNS records
tasks.help: Look up MX, SPF and DMARC. If you have a DKIM selector from a message or mail administrator, enter it to check its published key.

tasks.label: Read the authentication results on an email
tasks.help: Paste the original message headers locally to inspect the receiving server's reported results and delivery hops.

tasks.label: Inspect a saved website scan
tasks.help: Compare dated screenshots and observed requests with the evidence you collected about the domain.

tasks.label: Find where to report an abusive domain
tasks.help: Use the public domain or IP to find an appropriate contact and prepare a report with your evidence.

tasks.label: How many .ca domain sales were reported?
tasks.help: See NameBio’s reported sale count and dollar volume for the past year, then compare another extension in the same time window.

tasks.label: Can I read the Alderney ferry timetable with JavaScript off?
tasks.help: Read the dated browser measurement to see which departure information was visible and how much data the page transferred.

tasks.label: Has a regulator published a warning about this gambling domain?
tasks.help: Search the domain and open the regulator’s dated notice to check where it applies and what it says.

newspapers-and-local-history.title: Historical newspapers, maps and city directories
newspapers-and-local-history.intro: Look up an event, an address or a neighbourhood. Open a dated newspaper scan, compare Halifax aerial photos, or see which businesses a Halifax or Vancouver directory listed on a street.

tasks.label: Find a newspaper page about a historical event
tasks.help: Start with a saved scan and its publication date. Change the words, dates or newspaper to search the U.S. Chronicling America collection, which includes reporting on Canada.

tasks.label: See how a Halifax neighbourhood changed
tasks.help: Compare the same location in two aerial views. Start at Cogswell or the Dartmouth ferry landing, then open nearby photographs from the archives.

tasks.label: Look up an old Halifax or Vancouver street address
tasks.help: Compare two directory editions side by side and follow the citation to the printed listing. Street numbers and business names can change between editions.

tasks.label: Trace an unusual story through the newspapers
tasks.help: Choose a saved topic and read the original pages. Compare the papers, towns and publication dates to follow how the account spread.

tasks.label: Revisit Canada’s early community networks
tasks.help: Choose a network such as the Vancouver Community Network or Chebucto Community Net and follow its dated archived pages.

tasks.label: Which office used the Langley Prairie postmark?
tasks.help: Compare the name on the envelope with the cancellation date. On May 16, 1911, one office became Murrayville and another took the Langley Prairie name.

halifax-local-records.title: Halifax menus, maps and local records
halifax-local-records.intro: Follow a Halifax address from an old directory to an aerial photograph, compare posted restaurant prices, or look up what the municipality measured in a nearby lake.

tasks.label: Who traded on Upper Water Street?
tasks.help: Check how the printed address and occupant changed between directory editions. Each example links to the original page.

tasks.label: How did the Dartmouth ferry waterfront change?
tasks.help: Compare the Portland Street and ferry docks photograph with the later Queen Street and City Hall view. Open the same area on the dated aerial maps.

tasks.label: How high did Bedford Basin rise above the predicted tide during Dorian?
tasks.help: Compare the time of the highest measured difference at Bedford Institute with the storm’s track. The record identifies the gauge, units and hours with observations.

tasks.label: What was measured in Lake Banook?
tasks.help: Choose a monitoring station to see the oxygen and temperature readings by depth. The station page links to a comparison of two visits.

tasks.label: What did Halifax counters list for two donairs and extra sauce?
tasks.help: Compare the same order across the dated branch menus. Check the portion size before comparing sauce prices.

tasks.label: What do Halifax-area menus charge for clams and chips?
tasks.help: Read the portion description and the restaurant’s own menu alongside the listed price. Some restaurants quote market price.

tasks.label: Where are Nova Scotia clam landings recorded?
tasks.help: Compare commercial landings by year or open the 1931 county return for its barrels and canned cases.

tasks.label: What did inspectors report about a restaurant?
tasks.help: Use the establishment name and community to find the dated Nova Scotia inspection record.

tasks.label: Where did Dartmouth’s post office operate?
tasks.help: Trace the move to King and Portland in 1876, the move to Water and Ochterloney in 1891 and the brick post office built in 1894. The municipal heritage report identifies the buildings and streets.

tasks.label: How many restaurant locations are in Halifax?
tasks.help: Compare Halifax Regional Municipality with the wider metropolitan area using the same industry group and employer count. The boundaries overlap.

tasks.label: What does a two-bedroom apartment cost in Halifax?
tasks.help: Compare average advertised and paid rent in the same quarter, and see how the figures vary by apartment size.

tasks.label: Which licensed Halifax child-care programs serve my child’s age?
tasks.help: Review the services each facility reports and open the local directory to shortlist providers and confirm spaces.

metro-vancouver-local-records.title: Metro Vancouver transit, history and local data
metro-vancouver-local-records.intro: Check a SeaBus crossing, trace an address in a Vancouver directory, or compare observations for Langley and neighbouring communities.

tasks.label: How long is the wait after a missed SeaBus?
tasks.help: Open a direction to see scheduled crossings and the next departure. The separate historical counts describe seasonal ridership.

tasks.label: Who occupied a downtown Vancouver storefront?
tasks.help: Start with Hastings or Granville and compare the trade and occupant printed in each edition.

tasks.label: How many visits did Fort Langley record?
tasks.help: Look up the historic site’s fiscal-year attendance and compare it with another park or historic site.

tasks.label: How do Vancouver and Abbotsford–Mission compare?
tasks.help: Compare unemployment, employment and participation for the same three-month period. Each city has an individual history.

tasks.label: What internet speeds were measured in Langley and Vancouver?
tasks.help: Compare the network, month and test count alongside the median upload and download speeds.

tasks.label: What did ICBC record at Douglas Crescent and 203 Street?
tasks.help: See the published junction label, the road-project year and the reported crash counts in the years before and after the work.

tasks.label: How many passengers used the Bowen Island ferry?
tasks.help: Choose Route 08 and compare the same quarter in two years. The source report separates passenger totals, round trips and deck utilization.

tasks.label: When were coho recorded in Yorkson Creek?
tasks.help: Read the annual DFO estimates and survey years, then follow the creek to its mapped channel in Langley.

tasks.label: Which direction had the higher peak load on route 555?
tasks.help: Compare westbound and eastbound trips for the same season and day type. TransLink reports the average load at the busiest point as a percentage of vehicle capacity.

field_note.label: Work through the 555-to-501 transfer at Carvolth

tasks.label: How many restaurant locations are in Langley City and Township?
tasks.help: Compare the two municipalities in the same Statistics Canada table. See how many operating locations had employees in each place.

tasks.label: Which child-care programs are listed in Langley?
tasks.help: Start with provincial service records for the Langley locality. Compare age groups and contact providers about a specific date.

tasks.label: Which Golden Ears park notices affect my trip?
tasks.help: Check the dates, location and wording of each notice, then follow BC Parks for current conditions.

federal-access-records.title: Find federal access to information records in Canada
federal-access-records.intro: Start with a published request, find the department responsible for a record, or compare an institution’s annual statistics with the summaries it has released.

tasks.label: What has this institution already released?
tasks.help: Browse the institution’s publication history, open its filtered search and use the request number to find the official record or request a copy.

tasks.label: Which institution describes this kind of record?
tasks.help: Search federal record classes and personal information banks for the responsible organization and terminology used in its descriptions.

tasks.label: How many requests did the institution handle in a fiscal year?
tasks.help: Read annual administrative statistics separately from the completed summaries published in the federal catalogue. They count different populations and use different reporting periods.

tasks.label: Was a briefing note prepared on the subject?
tasks.help: Search briefing note titles for the department, date and reference number to narrow a request.

tasks.label: Has an access complaint led to a published decision?
tasks.help: Search published access decisions to find a case and follow it to the original document.

tasks.label: Where can I read the Arar inquiry and the government’s response?
tasks.help: Follow the inquiry’s findings in September 2006 to the apology and settlement announcement in January 2007. Both are linked to their official publications.

canadian-shopping-tools.title: Canadian shopping tools for prices, labels and recalls
canadian-shopping-tools.intro: Compare what two packages cost to use, check a Canadian origin claim, or look for an official recall before buying a product.

tasks.label: Which package costs less per use?
tasks.help: Use the prices on the shelf and the amounts on the labels to compare a load of laundry or a day of pet food. Change the example to match your purchases.

tasks.label: What part of this product was made in Canada?
tasks.help: Compare Québec cheese and coffee. Follow the producer and program sources to see which claims cover ingredients and which cover processing.

tasks.label: Has a toy been recalled in Canada?
tasks.help: Browse dated notices, then follow the official record to check the affected model or lot and the action the issuer recommends.

tasks.label: How do two food labels compare?
tasks.help: Enter two barcodes to compare the listed ingredients, allergens and serving sizes.

tasks.label: How does the price of eggs in Ontario compare with my carton?
tasks.help: Start with the provincial price for one dozen eggs. Adjust for the number of eggs in the carton and compare prices from the same month.

field_note.label: Calculate the break-even price for an 18-pack of eggs

tasks.label: How has the price of ground coffee changed in my province?
tasks.help: Open Commodity to shelf and compare two provinces for the same 340 g package. Use the same base month to compare price changes with the Arabica benchmark.

canadian-business-research.title: Canadian business and trade research
canadian-business-research.intro: Choose an industry, a place, a product or a trademark. Each example shows what the source counted and when.

tasks.label: How many restaurant locations are in each Langley?
tasks.help: Compare employer locations in Langley City and the Township of Langley for the same industry and edition. The municipal boundaries identify different places.

tasks.label: What do Canadian photography businesses spend?
tasks.help: Read the income and expense figures for the published revenue band, then enter your own figures privately to compare.

tasks.label: Who imports green coffee into Canada?
tasks.help: See which importers appear for unroasted, non-decaffeinated coffee. The concentration table reports the share held by groups of importers.

tasks.label: When was TrueNorth.bet registered as a trademark?
tasks.help: Follow the application number through filing, advertisement and registration. Compare the dates with the separately documented gaming authorization.

tasks.label: Which businesses appear in the Township licence file?
tasks.help: Find a named business or street in the municipal licence file and check the date of the observation.

tasks.label: Where does a province send its exports?
tasks.help: Choose a domestic export and compare trading destinations across the years covered.

moving-and-settling-in-canada.title: Planning a move to Canada or between provinces
moving-and-settling-in-canada.intro: Check the rent a new tenant might face, find child-care contacts and compare moving costs. If you are applying from abroad, look up the published processing estimate for your application type and country.

tasks.label: What does a two-bedroom apartment cost in Halifax?
tasks.help: Compare average advertised and paid rent in the same quarter, and see how the figures vary by apartment size.

field_note.label: See how a family can use the Halifax rent and child-care records together

tasks.label: Which licensed Halifax child-care programs serve my child’s age?
tasks.help: Review the services each facility reports and open the local directory to shortlist providers and confirm spaces.

tasks.label: Which licensed child-care providers in Moncton can I contact?
tasks.help: Check language of service and licensed age groups, save a shortlist and contact providers about fees, hours and openings.

tasks.label: What would the move change in my monthly budget?
tasks.help: Put your actual rent and job offer into a comparison and include one-time moving costs.

tasks.label: How have Canadian visa and permit estimates changed for applicants in India?
tasks.help: Compare visitor, study and work estimates for the same application country. Check the observation date and units before opening the official IRCC tool.

provincial-park-trip-planning.title: Planning a provincial park trip in BC or Nova Scotia
provincial-park-trip-planning.intro: Find out what to check before leaving for a BC park or choosing a reservation date in Nova Scotia. Each guide names the park, the time period and the source you can check before you book.

tasks.label: Which Sea-to-Sky parks suit the trip I have in mind?
tasks.help: Compare the facilities and dated notices for nearby parks, then open a park’s own BC Parks page.

tasks.label: What should I check before driving to Golden Ears?
tasks.help: Read the scope and dates of the published notices and look for gate information relevant to your visit.

tasks.label: How far ahead did people book Rissers Beach in July?
tasks.help: Compare Friday and Saturday arrivals with the rest of the week, then check the official reservation service for this season.

field_note.label: Compare July weekend RV bookings at Rissers Beach and Graves Island
